issues: asset_note: Line chart of Expansion (in. per 100 ft.) vs. Temperature (F) showing four curves for: (1) Carbon, carbon-1/2% molybdenum, and 1/2% chromium-1/2% molybdenum steels; (2) 1% to 3% chromium-1/2% to 1% molybdenum steels; (3) 4% to 10% chromium-1/2% to 1 1/2% molybdenum steels; (4) 18% chromium-8% nickel steels (AISI types 302, 303, 304, 321, 347). Bbox includes the figure title (top), the plot grid, the materials legend, and the reproduction note from M. W. Kellogg standard.
